WITH g AS (
  SELECT t.*, COALESCE(t.source_kind, t.group_kind) AS kind,
         COALESCE(CAST(t.source_id AS STRING), t.group_id) AS gid
  FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_warehouse, COALESCE(concat(d_warehouse.n, ' (', CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS n_warehouse, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))) END AS lbl_warehouse FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.query_top_by_cost t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING) AS warehouse_id, max(warehouse_name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING)) d_warehouse ON d_warehouse.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) AND d_warehouse.warehouse_id = CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) t
  WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
),
glabel AS (
  SELECT g.*,
         CASE
           WHEN kind = 'job' THEN COALESCE(j.n, concat('Job ', left(gid, 8)))
           WHEN kind = 'notebook' THEN COALESCE(nb.n, concat('Notebook ', left(gid, 8)))
           WHEN kind = 'pipeline' THEN COALESCE(p.n, concat('Pipeline ', left(gid, 8)))
           WHEN kind IS NULL THEN concat('Ad-hoc ', left(gid, 8))
           ELSE concat(initcap(kind), ' ', left(gid, 8))
         END AS group_label
  FROM g
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, job_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_job GROUP BY 1, 2) j
    ON j.workspace_id = g.workspace_id AND j.job_id = g.gid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, notebook_id, max(notebook_path) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_notebook GROUP BY 1, 2) nb
    ON nb.workspace_id = g.workspace_id AND nb.notebook_id = g.gid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, pipeline_id, max(pipeline_name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_pipeline GROUP BY 1, 2) p
    ON p.workspace_id = g.workspace_id AND p.pipeline_id = g.gid
),
rollup AS (
  SELECT group_kind, CASE WHEN group_kind = 'text hash' THEN NULL ELSE workspace_id END AS ws_key,
         group_id, statement_type,
         MAX_BY(group_label, runs) AS group_label,
         SUM(est_cost_usd_list) AS usd,
         SUM(runs) AS runs,
         SUM(p50_duration_ms * runs) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p50_duration_ms IS NOT NULL THEN runs END), 0) AS p50_ms,
         SUM(p95_duration_ms * runs) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p95_duration_ms IS NOT NULL THEN runs END), 0) AS p95_ms,
         SUM(read_files) AS read_files,
         SUM(pruned_files) AS pruned_files,
         MIN(CASE status WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'WARN' THEN 1 WHEN 'NOT_ASSESSED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) AS sev,
         count(DISTINCT warehouse_id) AS warehouses,
         MAX_BY(top_user, runs) AS top_user,
         max(last_seen) AS last_seen
  FROM glabel
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
)

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM rollup WHERE sev <= 1) AS value,
       concat('of ', CAST((SELECT count(*) FROM rollup) AS STRING), ' groups; over $50 or 20% of warehouse spend') AS target

WITH g AS (
  SELECT t.*, COALESCE(t.source_kind, t.group_kind) AS kind,
         COALESCE(CAST(t.source_id AS STRING), t.group_id) AS gid
  FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_warehouse, COALESCE(concat(d_warehouse.n, ' (', CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS n_warehouse, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))) END AS lbl_warehouse FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.query_top_by_cost t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING) AS warehouse_id, max(warehouse_name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING)) d_warehouse ON d_warehouse.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) AND d_warehouse.warehouse_id = CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) t
  WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
),
glabel AS (
  SELECT g.*,
         CASE
           WHEN kind = 'job' THEN COALESCE(j.n, concat('Job ', left(gid, 8)))
           WHEN kind = 'notebook' THEN COALESCE(nb.n, concat('Notebook ', left(gid, 8)))
           WHEN kind = 'pipeline' THEN COALESCE(p.n, concat('Pipeline ', left(gid, 8)))
           WHEN kind IS NULL THEN concat('Ad-hoc ', left(gid, 8))
           ELSE concat(initcap(kind), ' ', left(gid, 8))
         END AS group_label
  FROM g
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, job_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_job GROUP BY 1, 2) j
    ON j.workspace_id = g.workspace_id AND j.job_id = g.gid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, notebook_id, max(notebook_path) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_notebook GROUP BY 1, 2) nb
    ON nb.workspace_id = g.workspace_id AND nb.notebook_id = g.gid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, pipeline_id, max(pipeline_name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_pipeline GROUP BY 1, 2) p
    ON p.workspace_id = g.workspace_id AND p.pipeline_id = g.gid
),
rollup AS (
  SELECT group_kind, CASE WHEN group_kind = 'text hash' THEN NULL ELSE workspace_id END AS ws_key,
         group_id, statement_type,
         MAX_BY(group_label, runs) AS group_label,
         SUM(est_cost_usd_list) AS usd,
         SUM(runs) AS runs,
         SUM(p50_duration_ms * runs) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p50_duration_ms IS NOT NULL THEN runs END), 0) AS p50_ms,
         SUM(p95_duration_ms * runs) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p95_duration_ms IS NOT NULL THEN runs END), 0) AS p95_ms,
         SUM(read_files) AS read_files,
         SUM(pruned_files) AS pruned_files,
         MIN(CASE status WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'WARN' THEN 1 WHEN 'NOT_ASSESSED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) AS sev,
         count(DISTINCT warehouse_id) AS warehouses,
         MAX_BY(top_user, runs) AS top_user,
         max(last_seen) AS last_seen
  FROM glabel
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
)

SELECT concat(statement_type, ': ', group_label) AS group_name, warehouses, ROUND(usd * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS usd,
       runs, ROUND(p50_ms / 1000.0, 1) AS p50_s, ROUND(p95_ms / 1000.0, 1) AS p95_s,
       ROUND(100.0 * pruned_files / NULLIF(read_files + pruned_files, 0), 0) AS pruned_pct,
       COALESCE(top_user, '-') AS top_user,
       CASE sev WHEN 0 THEN 'CRITICAL' WHEN 1 THEN 'WARN' WHEN 2 THEN 'NOT_ASSESSED' ELSE 'OK' END AS status,
       date_format(last_seen, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS latest_run
FROM rollup
ORDER BY usd DESC
LIMIT 50

  FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`warehouse_name`, d_warehouse.n), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_warehouse, COALESCE(concat(COALESCE(t.`warehouse_name`, d_warehouse.n), ' (', CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS n_warehouse, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`warehouse_name`, d_warehouse.n), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`warehouse_name`, d_warehouse.n), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))) END AS lbl_warehouse FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.query_pruning_effectiveness t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING) AS warehouse_id, max(warehouse_name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING)) d_warehouse ON d_warehouse.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) AND d_warehouse.warehouse_id = CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING))
  WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')) AND warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
cache AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, warehouse_id, MAX(n_warehouse) AS n_warehouse,
         SUM(read_io_cache_percent_avg * scanned_query_count) / NULLIF(SUM(scanned_query_count), 0) AS cache_pct
  FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`warehouse_name`, d_warehouse.n), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_warehouse, COALESCE(concat(COALESCE(t.`warehouse_name`, d_warehouse.n), ' (', CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS n_warehouse, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`warehouse_name`, d_warehouse.n), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`warehouse_name`, d_warehouse.n), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))) END AS lbl_warehouse FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.query_cache_coldstart t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING) AS warehouse_id, max(warehouse_name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING)) d_warehouse ON d_warehouse.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) AND d_warehouse.warehouse_id = CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING))
  WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')) AND warehouse_id IS NOT NULL AND read_io_cache_percent_avg IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
whs AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, warehouse_id, n_warehouse FROM spill
  UNION SELECT workspace_id, warehouse_id, n_warehouse FROM shuffle
  UNION SELECT workspace_id, warehouse_id, n_warehouse FROM prune
  UNION SELECT workspace_id, warehouse_id, n_warehouse FROM cache
)
SELECT w.n_warehouse AS warehouse,
       ROUND(COALESCE(s.spill_bytes, 0) / 1e9, 1) AS spill_gb,
       ROUND(COALESCE(sh.shuffle_bytes, 0) / 1e9, 1) AS shuffle_gb,
       ROUND(c.cache_pct, 0) AS cache_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * p.pruned / NULLIF(p.pruned + p.read_f, 0), 0) AS prune_pct
FROM whs w
LEFT JOIN spill s ON s.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND s.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN shuffle sh ON sh.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND sh.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN prune p ON p.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND p.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN cache c ON c.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND c.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
ORDER BY spill_gb DESC
LIMIT 50

WITH q AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_warehouse, COALESCE(concat(d_warehouse.n, ' (', CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS n_warehouse, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))) END AS lbl_warehouse FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.query_queuing_waits t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING) AS warehouse_id, max(warehouse_name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING)) d_warehouse ON d_warehouse.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) AND d_warehouse.warehouse_id = CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')))
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(waiting_for_compute_ms_sum), 0) / 1000.0, 0) AS value,
       COALESCE((SELECT concat('Worst: ', nm_warehouse) FROM (
            SELECT nm_warehouse, SUM(waiting_for_compute_ms_sum) AS s FROM q GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1
       )), 'None waiting') AS target
FROM q

WITH m AS (
  SELECT hour_of_day, SUM(query_count) AS n
  FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_warehouse, COALESCE(concat(d_warehouse.n, ' (', CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS n_warehouse, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))) END AS lbl_warehouse FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.query_workload_mix_hours t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING) AS warehouse_id, max(warehouse_name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING)) d_warehouse ON d_warehouse.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) AND d_warehouse.warehouse_id = CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING))
  WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
  GROUP BY 1
), tot AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM m)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT hour_of_day FROM m ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1), 0) AS value,
       COALESCE((SELECT concat(lpad(CAST(hour_of_day AS STRING), 2, '0'), ':00 UTC, ',
                 CAST(ROUND(100.0 * n / NULLIF((SELECT total FROM tot), 0), 0) AS STRING), '% of statements')
                 FROM m ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1), 'No statements this window') AS target

WITH q AS (
  SELECT nm_warehouse, workspace_id, warehouse_id,
         SUM(waiting_at_capacity_ms_sum) AS slot_ms, SUM(waiting_for_compute_ms_sum) AS start_ms,
         SUM(query_count) AS queries
  FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_warehouse, COALESCE(concat(d_warehouse.n, ' (', CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS n_warehouse, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))) END AS lbl_warehouse FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.query_queuing_waits t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING) AS warehouse_id, max(warehouse_name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING)) d_warehouse ON d_warehouse.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) AND d_warehouse.warehouse_id = CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING))
  WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
pr AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, warehouse_id, scaling_hint FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.query_warehouse_pressure
)
SELECT q.nm_warehouse AS warehouse, ROUND(q.slot_ms / 1000.0, 0) AS slot_wait_s,
       ROUND(q.start_ms / 1000.0, 0) AS startup_wait_s, q.queries,
       COALESCE(pr.scaling_hint, '-') AS fix
FROM q
LEFT JOIN pr ON pr.workspace_id = q.workspace_id AND pr.warehouse_id = q.warehouse_id
ORDER BY slot_wait_s DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'query_warehouse_pressure', 'Warehouse memory & concurrency pressure', 'Capacity'),
       (1, 'query_queuing_waits', 'Queries waiting for a warehouse slot', 'Capacity'),
       (2, 'query_workload_mix_hours', 'Query workload by hour of day', 'Capacity'),
       (3, 'query_task_statement_breakdown', 'Statement breakdown by task stage', 'Capacity'),
       (4, 'perf_queue_by_hour', 'Queueing by day and hour', 'Capacity'),
       (5, 'query_slices', 'Query slices, reference', 'Capacity')) AS c(ord, query_id, title, page)
LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 1 WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.ord

COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))) END AS lbl_job, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(d_pipeline.n, CAST(t.`pipeline_id` databricks_audit_dashboard.perf_daily_by_resource t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'perf_daily_by_resource', 'Daily query, job and pipeline performance', 'Trend')) AS c(ord, query_id, title, page)
LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 1 WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.ord
